messages:
Iris Chen: Hi everyone — I'm Iris, joining Platform Eng today! First-day setup Qs: MDM enrollment link? who to ping for SSH access? also stickers :tada:
Leo Park: Welcome Iris!! :wave: You should have an invite to Okta/MDM — check your email. If not, DM me and I'll ping People Ops.
Iris Chen: I see Okta invite but MDM stuck on "enrolling" for >10m. Any tips?
Nora (IT): Hey Iris — try rebooting once, then open Company Portal > Devices > Enroll. If still stuck, paste the error here. Also make sure you're on home wifi (no captive portals).
Iris Chen: rebooted, still shows "pending". No error text.
Nora (IT): I'll kick off a re-enroll. Can you run: ```/usr/local/bin/companyportal enroll --debug``` and paste output? if mac, use the GUI first.
Sam W.: For SSH, add your public key to profile.redwood.com -> SSH keys. Quick commands: ```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "iris@redwood.com" && cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub``` then paste the output into the UI.
Iris Chen: thanks! did that and can ssh to bastion but hitting permission denied when trying to hop to devbox.
Sam W.: Try `ssh -A iris@bastion.redwood.local` then `ssh devbox-23` — forwarding the agent helps. If still denied, tell me the exact error.
Iris Chen: permission denied for devbox-23, says publickey.
Sam W.: I added your key to the devbox ACL, try again in 2 mins.
Aisha Rahman: Welcome Iris! I'm your onboarding buddy — 1:1 scheduled for Wed. Also stickers live near the kitchen, help yourself :slightly_smiling_face: 
Iris Chen: awesome, thanks Aisha! favorite snack question: mooncakes + oolong tea :yum: and I code to lo-fi.
Ben S.: Mooncakes. Respect. :coffee: Also if you want a desk plant, ping me and I'll grab one for you.
DevEx Bot: Iris Chen has been added to #platform, #eng, and #devex. Welcome pack shipped (tracking: XYZ123).
Iris Chen: Thanks all — Nora, Sam, Leo, Aisha. Will update here after trying the re-enroll + devbox retry.
Nora (IT): Re-enroll completed on our side — should show active now. If not, open a ticket with subject "MDM: Iris Chen" and tag @Nora.
Iris Chen: MDM now active and I can jump to devbox. First day win :tada: Thanks everyone!
Sam W.: 🎉 Nice. Ping here if anything else.
Leo Park: Welcome again! People Ops will send swag options — reply to the form if you have size/food prefs.
Iris Chen: Will do. Looking forward to being part of the team :)
